label: Build Shaders
args: ThirdParty\shaderc.exe -f Assets/Shaders/vs_triangle.sc -o Assets/Shaders/vs_triangle.h --type vertex --platform windows --profile s_5_0 -i Assets/Shaders/include --bin2c vs_triangle --varyingdef Assets/Shaders/varying.def.sc && ThirdParty\shaderc.exe -f Assets/Shaders/fs_triangle.sc -o Assets/Shaders/fs_triangle.h --type fragment --platform windows --profile s_5_0 -i Assets/Shaders/include --bin2c fs_triangle --varyingdef Assets/Shaders/varying.def.sc

label: Build Debug
args: xmake f -p windows -a x64 --vs=2022 -m debug && xmake build

label: Build Release
args: xmake f -p windows -a x64 --vs=2022 -m release && xmake build

label: Full Debug
args: ThirdParty\shaderc.exe -f Assets/Shaders/vs_triangle.sc -o Assets/Shaders/vs_triangle.h --type vertex --platform windows --profile s_5_0 -i Assets/Shaders/include --bin2c vs_triangle --varyingdef Assets/Shaders/varying.def.sc && ThirdParty\shaderc.exe -f Assets/Shaders/fs_triangle.sc -o Assets/Shaders/fs_triangle.h --type fragment --platform windows --profile s_5_0 -i Assets/Shaders/include --bin2c fs_triangle --varyingdef Assets/Shaders/varying.def.sc && xmake f -p windows -a x64 --vs=2022 -m debug && xmake build
